CutScene.Text: King Garranoth of the Dark Elves had no answers, only more questions. It seemed that he sought Aravein also.
But although Garranoth had no answers, he still had an interesting tale to tell…
It seemed that Aravein had been studying the Spell of Sundering - Prince Mordaine’s Spell – the one that caused the catastrophic events of 3000 years past.
That in itself was not unusual – many had studied this spell – but these studies had become an obsession with Aravein and driven her mad.
King Garranoth was concerned that she might try to cast the spell once more. And if this were so… then she must be stopped.
